requirements.title: Addressable LED Supply and Data Logic

patches.decision_note: LED supply and data-level compatibility have a separate trajectory from rail cutoff and MOSFET switching used to eliminate standby draw.

replacement.title: ESP32 Sleep and Wake Behavior
replacement.definition: Configure operating frequency, automatic light sleep, deep-sleep entry, and timer or touch-button wake behavior.

patches.decision_note: Sleep-state and wake-source behavior is independently implementable and does not belong to GPIO assignment compatibility.

replacement.title: ESP32 Local Supply Decoupling
replacement.definition: Place the required local decoupling capacitor sufficiently close to the ESP32 3V3 supply pin.

patches.decision_note: The capacitor placement is an independently targetable power-integrity constraint rather than module-selection or breakout behavior.

replacement.title: PIR and Touch Sensor Input Biasing
replacement.definition: Bias PIR and capacitive-touch inputs with pull-downs so unplugged active-high sensor inputs remain at a defined low level.

patches.decision_note: PIR and touch input biasing is electrically distinct from the active-low panel-button circuit.

replacement.title: Ambient-Light Sensor Interface
replacement.definition: Provide the requested I2C connector for an independently attached ambient-light sensor on the integrated board.

patches.decision_note: The ambient-light sensor connector is independently addable and is not part of the e-paper backlight driver.

replacement.title: Battery Charge Status Output
replacement.definition: Provide the intended battery-charge status LED circuit with correct resistor value and population handling.

patches.decision_note: The charge-status LED circuit is product behavior and should not be represented only as general BOM completeness.

replacement.title: Connector Pin Numbering and Labeling
replacement.definition: Keep physical connector pin numbering and signal labeling consistent with the intended cables and mating interfaces.

patches.decision_note: Physical pin numbering and labeling can be corrected independently from connector placement and board dimensions.

replacement.title: Manufacturable USB-C Connector Footprint
replacement.definition: Use a USB-C footprint whose mounting holes, drills, pads, and clearances pass fabrication checks and are accepted by the manufacturer.

patches.decision_note: The reported USB-C drill and annular-width violations define an independently testable footprint-manufacturability constraint.
